entries.title: Psalms 10:1
segments: ¶Why, Jehovah, standest thou afar off? [Why] hidest thou thyself in times of distress?

entries.title: Psalms 10:2
segments: The wicked, in his pride, doth hotly pursue the afflicted. They shall be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

entries.title: Psalms 10:3
segments: For the wicked boasteth of his soul's desire, and he blesseth the covetous; he contemneth Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 10:4
segments: The wicked [saith], in the haughtiness of his countenance, He doth not search out: all his thoughts are, There is no God!

entries.title: Psalms 10:5
segments: His ways always succeed; thy judgments are far above out of his sight; [as for] all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.

entries.title: Psalms 10:6
segments: He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; from generation to generation I shall be in no adversity.

entries.title: Psalms 10:7
segments: His mouth is full of cursing, and deceit, and oppression; under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 10:8
segments: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; in the secret places doth he slay the innocent: his eyes watch for the wretched.

entries.title: Psalms 10:9
segments: He lieth in wait secretly, like a lion in his thicket; he lieth in wait to catch the afflicted: he doth catch the afflicted, drawing him into his net.

entries.title: Psalms 10:10
segments: He croucheth, he boweth down, that the wretched may fall by his strong ones.

entries.title: Psalms 10:11
segments: He saith in his heart, *God hath forgotten, he hideth his face, he will never see [it].

entries.title: Psalms 10:12
segments: ¶Arise, Jehovah; O *God, lift up thy hand: forget not the afflicted.

entries.title: Psalms 10:13
segments: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? He hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require [it].

entries.title: Psalms 10:14
segments: Thou hast seen [it], for thou thyself beholdest trouble and vexation, to requite by thy hand. The wretched committeth himself unto thee; thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.

entries.title: Psalms 10:15
segments: Break thou the arm of the wicked, and as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness [till] thou find none.

entries.title: Psalms 10:16
segments: Jehovah is King for ever and ever: the nations have perished out of his land.

entries.title: Psalms 10:17
segments: Jehovah, thou hast heard the desire of the meek, thou hast established their heart: thou causest thine ear to hear,

entries.title: Psalms 10:18
segments: To do justice to the fatherless and the oppressed one, that the man of the earth may terrify no more.
